title: [MCP] Register MCP server as a Copilot capability
summary: The MCP server is now registered as a Copilot capability on the Copilot & agent capabilities page, allowing administrators to activate or deactivate it. Deactivating the capability updates the Copilot Settings status, which the platform reads to control MCP availability.
key_points: MCP server registered as a Generally Available, not billed Copilot capability with the standard Activate/Deactivate flow
Capability registered on install, on upgrade (tagged), and through the Copilot capabilities page subscriber
MCP Config List and Card pages show a notification when the capability is deactivated, with an action to open the capabilities page
Deactivating leaves existing MCP configurations untouched, so re-activating restores the feature immediately
Platform-side rejection of MCP requests when the capability is inactive is a separate follow-up change
